land and five men, the crew of brig Wickopee[?], whose vessel

Ship American Union, Armstrong, Havre, July 8th, Ashant 16th,
with mdse. and 406 pass. to Grinnell, Minturn & Co. Had one birth
on the passage. Had heavy SW and W gales; split sails, &c. Aug.
14, lat. 49 37, long. 44 12, spoke Br. bark Mary Elizabeth of and from
Welby[?], for Quebec, 45 days out, with loss of fore yard and short of
provisions; took from her Capt. Leland and five men, the crew of the
brig Wickopee, whose vessel was destroyed by fire July 18.
